description: Source code for the BidiPage class implementing PageDelegate in Playwright's server bidi module, handling browser context interactions, event handling, and page operations.

classes.name: BidiPage
classes.description: Implements PageDelegate to manage page interactions, event handling, and communication with the browser via the bidi protocol.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Initializes the main frame and sets up credentials.

methods.name: didClose
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the page is closed.

methods.name: _removeContextsForFrame
methods.description: Removes execution contexts associated with a frame.

methods.name: _onRealmCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of new realms (execution contexts or workers).

methods.name: _touchUtilityWorld
methods.description: Evaluates a script in the utility world to ensure its creation.

methods.name: _onLogEntryAdded
methods.description: Processes log entries, including JavaScript errors and console messages.

methods.name: navigateFrame
methods.description: Navigates a frame to a specified URL.

methods.name: updateExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Updates HTTP headers for the page.

methods.name: bringToFront
methods.description: Brings the page to the front.

methods.name: updateEmulatedViewportSize
methods.description: Updates the viewport size and screen orientation.

methods.name: updateFileChooserInterception
methods.description: Enables or disables file chooser interception.

methods.name: requestGC
methods.description: Requests garbage collection in the page context.

methods.name: _onScriptMessage
methods.description: Handles messages from scripts via the Playwright channel.

methods.name: addInitScript
methods.description: Adds a preload script to the page.

methods.name: removeInitScripts
methods.description: Removes preload scripts from the page.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the page.

methods.name: takeScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the page.

methods.name: getContentFrame
methods.description: Gets the frame associated with an element handle.

methods.name: getOwnerFrame
methods.description: Gets the owner frame of an element handle.

methods.name: getBoundingBox
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box of an element handle.

methods.name: _framePosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of a frame.

methods.name: scrollRectIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls an element into view if needed.

methods.name: rafCountForStablePosition
methods.description: Returns the number of requestAnimationFrame calls for stable position.

methods.name: getContentQuads
methods.description: Gets the quads for an element handle.

methods.name: adoptElementHandle
methods.description: Adopts an element handle into another context.

methods.name: pdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF of the page.

methods.name: getFrameElement
methods.description: Gets the frame element for a frame.

methods.name: _getFrameNode
methods.description: Locates the DOM node for a frame.

methods.name: shouldToggleStyleSheetToSyncAnimations
methods.description: Indicates if style sheet toggling is needed for animation sync.
